extDescription.message: Download whole TikTok short-drama series your own account can watch, paced like one person watching.

appSubtitle.message: Whole TikTok short-drama series, for offline viewing

uiLanguage.description: The language of this catalog, "en" or "es" (not a text to translate): the page shows the engine's texts in it.

statusRunning.description: Engine state badge: a job is running.

duplicateTab.message: DramaFetch is already open in another tab: use that one (one engine at a time).
duplicateTab.description: Banner of a second DramaFetch tab.

cooldownLeft.message: $minutes$ min left — nothing contacts TikTok until then.

linksLabel.message: One series link (any episode of it) or series id per line

linksHint.message: Load list shows the episodes of one series first. Download all takes every series of the box, one after the other, each listed right before its own downloads. Keep this tab open while DramaFetch works.

includeLockedLabel.message: Also ask for locked episodes (TikTok decides; usually they fail)

recheckLabel.message: Look again at series found complete in the last 24 hours

downloadAllButton.description: Button: download every series of the box.

selectAll.description: Accessible label of the select-all box.

seriesSkippedComplete.message: $name$ — complete on disk, nothing to do
seriesSkippedComplete.description: Header row of a series skipped as complete.

pauseInForce.description: The pause in force (the text is the engine's).

stopButton.description: Button: stop the run at the next pause.

failedHeading.description: Heading of the progress card's block of the episodes a job did not download (their count).

retryButton.message: Retry the episodes that did not download ($count$)
retryButton.description: Button: download the episodes that did not download again, one job per series.

reportButton.description: Button: save the report of the episodes the last job did not download (again, or when the setting is off).

reportSaved.description: The report of the episodes that did not download was saved (its file name).

reportNotSaved.message: The report could not be saved: $reason$
reportNotSaved.description: The report could not be saved (Chrome's reason).

resultTrimmed.message: Only the most recent episode rows are shown. Every series keeps its line below, and its row in the table at the end.
resultTrimmed.description: Under the result table once a long batch has dropped the rows of the episodes it finished long ago (the table keeps about the last 2000 rows).

storageRefused.message: DramaFetch stopped: $reason$. Chrome could not write to its profile folder — usually its disk is full. Free some space, restart Chrome and run again: what is already saved is skipped.
storageRefused.description: Shown when chrome.storage.local refused to store DramaFetch's progress: the engine's reason in the page's language (it ends with Chrome's own words), and what to do.

loading.message: Listing the series in a background tab… this usually takes 10–40 s.

noLinks.message: Paste at least one series link or id.

loadOneOnly.message: Load list takes one series; use Download all for several.

loadAlreadyQueued.message: That series is already being listed; wait for the running job.

seriesMeta.message: $episodes$ episodes listed, $available$ available (free or unlocked by your account), $ondisk$ already on disk.

selectionLocked.message: ($count$ locked: will be asked for, usually fails)

badgeFreeTitle.message: Free to watch: downloaded with your session

badgeUnlockedTitle.message: A paid episode your TikTok account has unlocked: downloaded with your session, like a free one

badgeLockedTitle.message: Your account has not unlocked it (or it is protected by DRM): skipped; nothing is ever unlocked

badgeOnDisk.description: Badge of an episode already saved.

badgeOnDiskTitle.message: Already downloaded: downloading again skips it without a request

settingReport.message: Save a report of the episodes that did not download

settingReportHint.message: A JSON file in Downloads/DramaFetch/reports: for each episode that did not download, its status, message, probable cause, the requests made (hosts, HTTP statuses, sizes) and the list entry TikTok served to your session — never your cookies.

settingsHint.message: File names may use {series}, {number}, {n}, {title} and {id}. Pauses may only be made longer than the defaults (4–9 s between episodes, 60–120 s every 10): faster is never safe against TikTok.

historyFailed.description: History line: a past run's episodes that did not download (E02, E07; per series when the run had several).

testHeading.description: Heading of the test card (test copy only).

testLabel.message: Test settings (JSON), honoured only by this test copy of the extension
testLabel.description: Label of the test settings box.

popupSeries.description: Popup: the series of this tab.

popupHint.message: Open a TikTok short drama to download its whole series, or paste links in the DramaFetch tab.

legalNotice.message: DramaFetch is for personal, offline viewing of episodes that your own TikTok account can already watch. It does not unlock paid episodes and does not bypass DRM or access controls; locked episodes are listed and skipped. Downloading may breach TikTok's Terms of Service, and the videos belong to their creators and studios — you are responsible for how you use this tool.
legalNotice.description: The README's legal notice, verbatim, in English (both locales).

legalNoticeSpanish.message: DramaFetch es para ver sin conexión, de forma personal, episodios que tu propia cuenta de TikTok ya puede ver. No desbloquea episodios de pago y no elude el DRM ni los controles de acceso; los episodios bloqueados se listan y se omiten. Descargar puede infringir las Condiciones del servicio de TikTok, y los videos pertenecen a sus creadores y estudios — eres responsable de cómo usas esta herramienta.
legalNoticeSpanish.description: The legal notice in Spanish (both locales).
